title: Death Notifier
description: This mod detects whenever you die and than sends a discord message via webhook.
body:
**Death Notifier**

Get a Discord notification every time you die — with the exact death message, cause, and killer info sent straight to a webhook of your choice.

---

**Features**
- Sends a rich Discord embed on every death
- Shows the exact death message from the game
- Detects what killed you and categorizes it:
  - ⚔️ Player kill — shows killer's name
  - 👾 Mob kill — shows mob name with thumbnail
  - 🧱 Block/environmental — shows block image
  - ☠️ Environment — fall damage, void, starvation, etc.
- Embed color changes based on kill type
- Shows the server address you died on
- Fully client-side — works on any server, no install needed

---

**Setup**
1. Install the mod alongside Fabric API
2. Join any server
3. Run `/deathnotifier setwebhook <your webhook url>`
4. Run `/deathnotifier test` to verify it's working

---

**Commands**
- `/deathnotifier setwebhook <url>` — set your Discord webhook
- `/deathnotifier status` — check if a webhook is configured
- `/deathnotifier test` — send a test notification

---

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
